slice_description: Native art for 17 exact registered Harvestable output identities: eight original 16x24 product cells and nine unchanged borrowed cells. Eligible world and carried-reader routes share current-owner, graph, visibility, custody, single-cell footprint, part, stack and semantic guards; unsupported altered owners retain truthful glyphs. No quantities, recipes, prices, item mechanics, world generation or optional animation changed. Previously approved regional and portable art remains inherited.
source_provenance: Full revision and source-freeze time asserted by the root build operator. Both successful receipts identify the requested fresh outputs and start after that boundary. This helper does not query Git or independently prove source-to-binary reproducibility.
default_presentation: Flat16x24 when no saved explicit choice exists

receipts.scope: Final combined native suite: 123 harvest-product cases and 276 related cases; all 399 distinct identities passed, zero failed, skipped or inconclusive. Synthetic registered-biome contexts are not natural travel or actual captures from all biomes. Already recorded; this helper does not run tests.

native_test_evidence.limits: The single combined final receipt contains 399 distinct identities, all passed; no failed, skipped or inconclusive cases are permitted. This packaging process executes no tests. Native synthetic context coverage does not establish natural discovery or actual biome travel.

coverage_limits: These 17 registered Harvestable outputs do not complete all items, crops, raw resources, recipe outputs, biomes or whole scenes. Eight new cells and nine unchanged borrowed cells are identity coverage, not evidence that every product was naturally obtained or seen in packaged gameplay.
Unimplemented identities retain truthful glyphs/colors. Other regions and whole-scene fullness remain incomplete; nuanced new animation remains deferred.
Build/archive integrity does not certify gameplay, physical controls, full journeys, audio quality or device performance.
build_generated_settings: Root reviews/restores only build-generated settings separately. This helper does not edit project settings or saves.
